note: The spade's sounds (docs/future/13 10.4.3, P2c): short CC0 takes played through src/audio/keepsake-sounds.js on the tools bus when src/world/dig emits dig:sound, each peaked at -3 dBFS. The bite at the step names the layer (topsoil a soft muffled thud, subsoil a gritty scrape with stone ticks, clay a wet suck as the blade pulls free, sand a soft hiss); lift as the knees bend; pour as the spoil tips onto its heap (pour-sand on sand); stones the ringing clink of the shovel on stone, when there is nothing deeper to dig. The sound teaches the layer before the eye does. db sets each one's level; pitchCents is a small seeded spread (the dug cell seeds it, so the same spot sounds the same). Sources are in assets/audio/CREDITS.md.
